Hi Lynn

Please confirm you have the following settings entered on the outgoing server settings. Incorrect Security and port values are the likely reason for the error message you observe.

Server = mail.twc.com Security = StartTLS Port = 587 Authentication = Normal password username = [your email address] password = [your password] client certificate = none

The other options you mention below apply only on the incoming server settings screen.

Client Certificate = None Auto-detect IMAP namespace = Ticked Imap path prefix = empty Use compression = Ticked Sent client information = Ticked
